title: Cafe Rise 147 |  The Quest Begins | Infinity Rising
description:
In this episode Rob and Josh look back on a year defined by major delivery and steady evolution. They discuss the successful launches on Epic and Steam, why maintaining a high bar for quality has been critical, and how rebranding the project set the foundation for its next phase.
They also break down key gameplay advancements, including the release of Avatar 3.0, the introduction of combat, and the early quest system designed to better guide new players into the world. The conversation touches on the importance of node operations behind the scenes, the impact of community feedback on development decisions, and what players can expect next, from seasonal changes to new mechanics planned for future expansions.

🔔 Don’t miss out, like, subscribe, and hit the bell to stay ahead of every drop.

00:00 Beverage Choices
02:08 Year In Summary
19:44 Quests - Coming Build
28:05 Nodes & Summit
33:10 Custom Domes
34:00 Leak!
36:25 Community Questions

Infinity Rising is an open-world sandbox MMO and multiverse simulator set between Cornucopias, the nation in the sky, the fractured Earth below, and the unknown worlds beyond. Born from the aftermath of the Calamity—a quantum storm that shattered reality—players rebuild civilization under vast domes powered by advanced quantum tech. 

Guided by “The Messenger,” you’ll explore, gather, craft, trade, and defend in a player-driven economy across land, sky, and beyond. Quantum Rifts, mysterious anomalies tied to The Prophet and The Terra, challenge survival and progress as players rise into infinite possibilities. Whether you craft, farm, fight, or build empires, every choice shapes the future of the Cornucopias Republic—humanity’s last beacon of hope. 

Infinity Rising is a call to ascend without end—world, player, and technology together.
